model: Smart Strainer 118501 differential pressure monitoring kit (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Watts Smart Strainer kit 118501 for differential pressure monitoring and automatic flushing of strainer screens.
summary: The Smart Strainer kit measures inlet and outlet pressure and temperature across a strainer screen and works out how full the basket is. On strainer models with an automatic flush ball valve it opens the valve when the pressure drop passes a set threshold. Over BACnet MS/TP it reports seven Analog Inputs, five alarm and status inputs and a flush status value.
notes: Object list taken from the PICS object lists and range table; it gives no separate descriptions, so short ones are added here.
AI and BI Present_Value is writable only when Out_Of_Service is true. BV 0 Present_Value is writable.
Pressure and temperature ranges depend on the fitted sensor.
Copy taken from the BACnet International product catalog; dated August 24, 2026.

source.title: BACnet Protocol Implementation Conformance Statement - Smart Strainer 118501

integration.summary: Poll the inlet and outlet pressures and the basket fill level, and map the three level alarms and the leak input to BMS alarms. The valve-open input and flush status show when the strainer is flushing.
setup: MS/TP data rates 9600 to 115200; Max_Master 0-127 and Max_Info_Frames 1-255 are writable on the Network Port object.
The PICS lists 10K ohm bias resistors on the MS/TP port.
gotchas: The PICS does not say what writing BV 0 does; test before using it as a flush command.
